info.title: GenAI Output Messages
info.description: Schema for the gen_ai.output.messages attribute, describing the messages generated by a GenAI model or agent.

OutputMessages.description: Represents the list of output messages generated by the model or agent.

BlobPart.description: Represents blob binary data sent inline to the model
x-otel-deviation: OTel allows arbitrary additional properties, while this definition does not.
The content field is omitted.
The modality field is optional because libraries may not expose the modality.

type.description: The type of the content captured in this part.

mime_type.description: The IANA MIME type of the attached data.

modality.description: The general modality of the data if it is known.

ChatMessage.description: Represents an output message generated by the model or agent. The output message captures specific response (choice, candidate).
x-otel-deviation: OTel names this definition OutputMessage.
OTel allows arbitrary additional properties, while this definition does not.
The deprecated finish_reason field is omitted. Finish reasons belong in gen_ai.response.finish_reasons.

role.description: Role of the entity that created the message.

parts.description: List of message parts that make up the message content.

x-otel-deviation: OTel's TranscriptionPart is omitted. Transcripts are dropped and may be captured as part of existing audio parts in the future.
OTel's ServerToolCallPart and ServerToolCallResponsePart are omitted due to overlap with GenericPart. Server-side tool calls and results are recorded as GenericPart.

CompactionPart.description: Represents compacted conversation state sent to or received from the model.
x-otel-deviation: OTel allows arbitrary additional properties, while this definition does not.
The id field is omitted.

type.description: The type of the content captured in this part.

content.description: The unencrypted compacted conversation summary, when available.

FilePart.description: Represents an external referenced file sent to the model by file id
x-otel-deviation: OTel allows arbitrary additional properties, while this definition does not.
The modality field is optional because libraries may not expose the modality.
The file_id field is optional because libraries may not expose the file identifier.

type.description: The type of the no content captured in this part.

mime_type.description: The IANA MIME type of the attached data.

modality.description: The general modality of the data if it is known. Instrumentations SHOULD also set the mimeType field if the specific type is known.

file_id.description: An identifier referencing a file that was pre-uploaded to the provider.

GenericPart.description: Fallback for consumers when a message part has a `type` not defined by this conventions' version. When the instrumented API sends or returns content that none of the defined part types fit, record the part keeping the provider's fields.

type.description: The type of the content captured in this part, prefixed with the value with `gen_ai.provider.name` (for example `anthropic.search_result`) to avoid name collisions with current or future part types defined by semantic conventions.

x-otel-deviation: The transcription, server_tool_call and server_tool_call_response types are not excluded, because this schema omits the corresponding part definitions.

ReasoningPart.description: Represents reasoning/thinking content received from the model.
x-otel-deviation: OTel allows arbitrary additional properties, while this definition does not.
The content field is optional because libraries may not expose the reasoning content.

type.description: The type of the content captured in this part.

content.description: Reasoning/thinking content received from the model.

ToolCallRequestPart.description: Represents a tool call requested by the model.
x-otel-deviation: OTel allows arbitrary additional properties, while this definition does not.
The id field is omitted.
The name field is optional because libraries may not expose the tool name.

type.description: The type of the content captured in this part.

ToolCallResponsePart.description: Represents a tool call result sent to the model or a built-in tool call outcome and details.
x-otel-deviation: OTel allows arbitrary additional properties, while this definition does not.
The id field is omitted.
The response field is optional because libraries may not expose the tool call response.

type.description: The type of the content captured in this part.

UriPart.description: Represents an external referenced file sent to the model by URI
x-otel-deviation: OTel allows arbitrary additional properties, while this definition does not.
The modality field is optional because libraries may not expose the modality.
The uri field is optional because libraries may not expose the URI.

type.description: The type of the content captured in this part.

mime_type.description: The IANA MIME type of the attached data.

modality.description: The general modality of the data if it is known. Instrumentations SHOULD also set the mimeType field if the specific type is known.

uri.description: A URI referencing attached data. It should not be a base64 data URL, which should use the `blob` part instead. The URI may use a scheme known to the provider api (e.g. `gs://bucket/object.png`), or be a publicly accessible location.
